sourceBaseline: Recovery worktree at 2dfa2f2e, where the module is new in this task and untracked; byte-identical to the copy preserved from managed pre-push run 5
originalFailure: Managed pre-push run 5 on the macOS development host, affected agent-test stage: FAIL at line 42 with 'AssertionError: AdapterBlocked not raised' after 5.01 s (runner timing elapsedSeconds 5.010079083032906).
originalFailureLogScope: Preserved failure excerpt of that run: this trace, the runner timing line and the idle probe note.
hostMeasurement: On the same Active Directory-bound host, /usr/bin/ssh -F /dev/null -S <owned absent directory>/m -O check (OpenSSH_10.2p1, LibreSSL 3.3.6) exits 255 in milliseconds with stderr 'Control socket connect(<path>): No such file or directory' ending in CRLF: median 3.7 ms and maximum 5.5 ms over 300 runs under sweep load. The client imports getservbyname, getpwuid and getaddrinfo, and opendirectoryd records a getpwuid and a getservbyname request from each such ssh process. Its persisted log shows 'reconnect timed out after 10 seconds' 27 times in 17 distinct minutes between 02:32 and 05:52, the window between the preserved run 4 and run 5 failure copies.
confirmedCause: load() bounded each actual observation by time.monotonic()+5. The fixture's real _bounded collector reads the /usr/bin/ssh -O check child of the owned absent socket until both streams close or that deadline passes and then terminates it. On this Active Directory-bound host the ssh client's service lookup (getservbyname) goes through opendirectoryd, and while opendirectoryd's directory reconnect is timing out such a lookup waits about 10 s. A child launched in that window cannot finish within 5 s, so _bounded returned complete False, the beforeimage's _failure() returned 'unavailable' instead of raising connection_outcome_unknown, and the case failed with 'AdapterBlocked not raised' at its deadline. The stall was observed directly during this task's verification (hostReproduction); the run 5 child itself was not traced, but such reconnect timeouts recur throughout that run's window. The CRLF recognizer under test, its readiness_transport fixtures and the twelve controlled cases are not involved.
hostReproduction: During this task's loaded verification of the fix, in a round that still ran an earlier version of this regression whose stand-in delay was 6 s (two concurrent copies of test_ssh_nested_control_crlf plus that version beside a 24-worker CPU burner), both copies' first actual control checks (ssh PIDs 81908 and 81909: the unwrapped old() observation of the module's own actual case, which each copy ran first) sent getservbyname to opendirectoryd at 10:15:40.955 and exited at 10:15:50.963 and 10:15:50.968, just after opendirectoryd logged 'reconnect timed out after 10 seconds' and 'time: 10.006 - excessive time in seconds' at 10:15:50.962. Under the 60 s bound that case passed after the 10 s stall, and each copy's 14 tests took 22.175 s instead of the 12.1-12.3 s of every other run of that 6 s version; the committed 11 s version takes about 22.1 s without any stall. With the old 5 s deadline the same stall gives the run 5 failure.
fix: load() bounds each actual observation by OBSERVE_SECONDS = 60, well past the 10 s directory reconnect stall. Every assertion, both actual observations and all twelve controlled and negative cases are unchanged.
controlledRegression: agent_tools.tests.test_ssh_nested_control_crlf_deadline runs the actual test_actual_openssh_absent_socket_full_before_red_fixed_green case of this whole beforeimage (compiled from these bytes in a private module whose __file__ is the current module's) and of the current module concurrently. Only a launch whose argv is a case's exact /usr/bin/ssh -F /dev/null -S <its socket> -O check public-local-no-network goes through an owned wrapper: the current interpreter in isolated mode records its pid, sleeps 11 s (a fixed stand-in for the 10 s reconnect stall, past the old 5 s bound) and then execs the real /usr/bin/ssh in the same process with the same arguments, streams and environment. Every wrapper is an owned child; one still running at the end is killed and reaped.
failingEvidence: Unfixed (an isolated clone holding this beforeimage as test_ssh_nested_control_crlf.py, with this regression and fixture), unsandboxed: the regression FAILs after 5.0 s idle, as two concurrent copies beside a 24-worker CPU burner (5.08 and 5.09 s) and through the managed plan runner (reaped, no descendant leak). Its beforeimage half first reproduces the original failure exactly (line 42, the original statement, 'AssertionError: AdapterBlocked not raised', at least 5 s, its one control-check launch stopped with a negative return code); then the unfixed module's own actual case fails with the identical line 42 'AdapterBlocked not raised' at its 5 s deadline. Nine mutants are killed unsandboxed: the fix with the old 5 s bound (5.02 s), a 7 s bound that a 6 s stand-in would pass (7.02 s) or a 10 s bound at the observed stall (10.01 s); the 60 s bound applied only to the before observation ('unavailable' != 'dead', 16.07 s) or only to the fixed one (5.02 s); an unfinished capture skipped instead of failed under the old bound (one skip, 5.02 s); and in the regression the wrapper unused (0.07 s) or a 4 s delay below the old bound (8.10 s), where the unfixed case passes, and only the first launch per socket delayed (one recorded fixed launch, 11.07 s).
passingEvidence: Fixed, unsandboxed: the beforeimage still fails at its 5 s deadline with the original message, while the current case passes after both of its observations outwaited the 11 s delay with the exact rc 255 CRLF capture; both fixed launches went through the wrapper and exited 255. test_ssh_nested_control_crlf plus this regression (14 tests) pass idle in 22.13 s with PYTHONWARNINGS=error, through the managed plan runner (22.1 s, reaped, no descendant leak) and as two concurrent copies beside an owned CPU burner of 12, 24 and 36 workers (22.14-22.17 s each, load average up to about 30). With the appended reviewed pin the selector exits 0 and selects this regression for changes to the module, its readiness_transport fixtures, this beforeimage and this provenance; the 22 dependency-manifest consumer modules (278 tests) pass.
sandboxRunnerLimit: The sandbox-exec classification runner's profile denies exec of /usr/bin/ssh, so there the original actual case errors before and after this fix and this regression's fixed half cannot run; both modules need the unsandboxed runner, as the actual OpenSSH observation always did.
routineSuite: agent_tools.tests.test_ssh_nested_control_crlf_deadline runs in the affected agent-test stage of the managed pre-push tier and the Fast Checks agent shards whenever the selector reaches it, including changes to test_ssh_nested_control_crlf.py, its readiness_transport fixtures, this beforeimage or this provenance.
nativeEvidenceLimit: Local test-harness observation deadline only: the child is the local OpenSSH client against an owned absent control socket. No TCP connection, SSH host, VM, guest or product native behavior is involved or claimed.
